newsitem.title: USA: FPC sees Fla. nuke at 100 pct by early Sat.
newsitem.headline: FPC sees Fla. nuke at 100 pct by early Sat.

text.p: Florida Power Corp's (FPC) 825 megawatt (MW) Crystal River nuclear unit 3 will not return to full power until early Saturday, a few hours later than previously expected, the company said Friday.

"We are going down to 42 percent to work on a bus duck cooling unit," said company spokesman Melanie Forbrick, noting three belts needed to be repaired before the unit could resume ramping up the unit.
She added that it would take about seven hours after repairs are completed to reach full power, which would most likely be early Saturday.
Repairs to the pipe that leads to the circulating water pump were almost finished, she said.
Before the power reduction, the Red Level, Fla., unit was operating at about 84 percent power since early Monday for planned maintenance.
Florida Power is a subsidiary of Florida Progress Corp.
